instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, the notebook goes on the pile of books, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

attempts.code:
# Observe and get grasp candidates for yellow_notebook
obs = observe()
table_z = obs["table_z"]
cands = grasp_candidates("yellow_notebook")

# Pick the best edge pinch candidate that is reachable and has free space below edge
chosen = None
for c in cands:
    if c.get("edge_free_below") and c.get("reachable_checked"):
        chosen = c
        break

if chosen is None:
    for c in cands:
        if c.get("edge_free_below"):
            chosen = c
            break

if chosen is None:
    chosen = cands[0]

# Execute edge pinch: move to pre-grasp back along approach, advance, close, lift
app = chosen.get("approach", [1.0, 0.0, 0.0])
fa = chosen.get("finger_axis", [0.0, 0.0, 1.0])
gx = chosen["x"]
gy = chosen["y"]
gz = table_z + chosen["height"]

# Pre-grasp offset 5 cm back along approach
pre_x = gx - 0.05 * app[0]
pre_y = gy - 0.05 * app[1]
pre_z = gz - 0.05 * app[2]

open_gripper()
move_gripper(pre_x, pre_y, pre_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")
move_by(dx=0.05 * app[0], dy=0.05 * app[1], dz=0.05 * app[2])
close_gripper()

# Lift straight up to safe transit height keeping hand/notebook orientation
# Note: Keep grip point > 0.11m above obstacles/book_pile
bp = obs["zones"]["book_pile"]
pile_top_z = table_z + bp["top_height"]
safe_z = pile_top_z + 0.15

# Lift up
curr = gripper_pose()
move_gripper(curr["position"][0], curr["position"][1], safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")

# Target placement position: book pile center
# Keep notebook level and above the pile, accounting for grasp offset
offset_x = gx - obs["objects"]["yellow_notebook"]["center"][0]
offset_y = gy - obs["objects"]["yellow_notebook"]["center"][1]
target_grip_x = bp["center"][0] + offset_x
target_grip_y = bp["center"][1] + offset_y

# Move horizontally above book pile
move_gripper(target_grip_x, target_grip_y, safe_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fa, path="line")

# Lower notebook onto book pile until contact
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.12)
go_home()

Pick up the yellow_notebook and place it onto the book_pile. Task success is verified when yellow_notebook rests on book_pile while green_mug remains on blue_coaster, cyan_pen remains in magenta_holder, and purple_paper remains in red_bin.
